question: PQ is a diameter of a circle and PS is a chord. If PQ is 82 cm and PS is 80 cm, the distance (in cm) of PS from the center of the circle is:
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the circle, PQ = 82 cm

Chord of the circle, PS = 80 cm

**Formula Used:**

Using the right triangle property in a circle:

If a chord is perpendicular to the diameter, the formula to find the distance from the center to the chord is:

Distance = sqrt{r² - (c/2)²}

Where, r = radius of the circle, c = length of the chord

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa51723373cea246f13776398f4259bdc700d6952ab1de400912bd1b031d9a8a.png] 

Radius, r = PQ / 2 = 82 / 2 = 41 cm

Half of the chord, c/2 = 80 / 2 = 40 cm

Distance from the center = sqrt{41² - 40²}

Distance = sqrt{1681 - 1600}

Distance = sqrt{81}

Distance = 9 cm

**The distance of PS from the center of the circle is 9 cm.**
